name: ElizaWP – SEO MCP for AI Agents
author: ElizaWP

sections.description:
SEO work is repetitive at scale. Auditing pages, updating meta fields, plugging content gaps, and adding schema takes hours of switching between tools and copying things back into WordPress. ElizaWP connects Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor directly to your site and Google Search Console so you can execute in minutes what used to take an afternoon.

  • Scan Google Search Console to find traffic opportunities your site is missing
  • Research keywords by funnel stage based on real search demand
  • Analyze competitor content gaps and surface ideas your site does not cover
  • Write complete, publish-ready posts built around a real target keyword
  • Let your AI read and rewrite any post, page, or custom post type
  • Update SEO titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords across your SEO plugin of choice
  • Add or replace header tags and JSON-LD schema without touching code
  • Structure content to appear in AI Overviews and AI answer engines
  • Review a full activity log to see exactly what your AI changed

Works with your SEO plugin. Header tags and schema work on any site. Titles and meta descriptions require one of the plugins below.

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • All in One SEO
  • SEOPress
  • The SEO Framework
  • Squirrly SEO
  • SureRank
  • Slim SEO

External services

This plugin connects to ElizaWP at elizawp.com.

It sends site URL, site name, REST API URL, a site API key, connection status, Search Console related project data, optional AI traffic events, and the data you ask the agent to read or write on your site. This is required to link the site to your ElizaWP project and to run the SEO tools.

Service site: https://elizawp.com/
Terms: https://elizawp.com/terms/
Privacy: https://elizawp.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the zip.
  2. Activate ElizaWP.
  3. Open ElizaWP in wp-admin and choose Continue with ElizaWP.
  4. Finish project setup in your ElizaWP account, then return to WordPress.
sections.faq:
What is MCP?

MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It is an open standard that lets AI clients like Claude and Cursor connect to external tools. ElizaWP provides an MCP endpoint so your AI can access your site content directly, rather than you pasting things back and forth.

Do I need an ElizaWP account?

Yes. Create a free account at elizawp.com to set up your first project and get your MCP endpoint. The plugin on its own does not run without a connected project.

Does ElizaWP publish posts without my review?

No. Content is saved as a draft unless you, or an agent you explicitly authorize, choose to publish.

Is my content safe?

Your AI only reads or writes what you instruct it to in the chat. Nothing is published unless you or an agent you explicitly authorize chooses to publish. All activity is logged so you can review it at any time.

Do I need an SEO plugin?

You need a compatible SEO plugin for titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords. Header tags and schema work without one.

What AI clients work with ElizaWP?

Any AI client that supports MCP works with ElizaWP. This includes Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, and Continue. More clients are adding MCP support regularly.

Where is the MCP endpoint?

After you connect a project, copy the endpoint and token from your ElizaWP account MCP page.
